newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates C-C Amatil Euro MTN.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates C-C Amatil Euro MTN.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it has assigned a AA minus rating to Coca-Cola Amatil ltd's proposed US$750 million Euro medium-term note programme.
At the same time, S&P has affirmed its AA minus long-term corporate rating of C-C Amatil and the rating outlook remains negative.
Today's rating covers a 300 million mark Eurobond maturing November 6, 2001 under the EMTN programme.

The ratings reflect C-C Amatil's strong operational linkage with the U.S. based major share holder The Coca-Cola Company (Coke), rated AA/A-1 plus, sustainable profitable growth, and leading market positions in major franchise territories.
These are offset by C-C Amatil's narrow business mix and aggressive overseas expansion, particularly in the less-developed regions with higher risk exposure.
C-C Amatil is 26 percent owned by Coca-Cola Co.
